**Findings on Default Method:**
The default method of execution for capital crimes in Kentucky is lethal injection. However, under Kentucky Revised Statutes (KRS) § 431.220, inmates who received a death sentence prior to March 31, 1998, have the option to choose between lethal injection and electrocution.
